title: Restricted junta sample count
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin }n$, and let the failure parameter be rational and lie in $(0,1/2]$. The restricted sample count is the cardinality of the family of subsets of the coordinates outside $P$ of size at most $\lfloor 3k/4\rfloor$, multiplied by the coefficient estimation sample count, plus the junta polynomial sample count.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin }n$
The failure parameter is rational and lies in $(0,1/2]$
